scope: All 199 measured v3 archive members mapped to Git clean-filter identities and actual staged publication blobs. No measured product bytes were rewritten.
method: Binary subprocess input/output to git hash-object --path and git cat-file; no PowerShell text conversion. Stage/index is reversible; this record does not claim publication or a new release.
line_ending_qualification: The measured wheel was built from the archived raw source bytes. Repository text rules normalize some Git blobs to LF. Those blobs are mapped explicitly and are not relabeled as byte-identical measured build inputs.
